newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 11 trln rbls in bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 11 trln rbls in bills, bonds.

text.p: The Russian finance ministry will offer 8.50 trillion roubles of six-month GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22061) and 2.50 trillion roubles of a new 588-day tranche of two-year OFZ interest-bearing government bonds maturing in July 1998 (series 24008) on December 4, the central bank said on Wednesday.
Full details of the T-bill auction:
NOTE - Although the issue runs for more than eight months, it is officially classified as six-month paper.
Full details of the bond issue:
In money terms, the January 15 coupon amounts to 121,018 roubles, less accruals of 65,164 roubles.
On December 4, the finance ministry will also repay about 7.08 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of six-month T-bills (series 22035).
